summary: Iteration 2 — full re-test after restructure (Catalogue + Actue + Academy + Builder + Profil; Compare/Benchmarks moved to nested routes; catalog expanded 20→48 tools with Clearbit logos; 7 news, 5 lessons, 8 templates added). Backend: 25/25 pytest passed. Frontend: all new screens render, all expected testIDs found, live preview / reset / copy / sub-tabs / lesson detail / template list work. Match wizard, ratings, benchmarks, compare nav all green.

issues: Persistent React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents). Same as iter 1, cosmetic only.

Console warning: '[Layout children]: No route named "search" exists in nested children'. The (tabs)/_layout.tsx likely still references a removed `search` Tabs.Screen entry — should be cleaned up to remove the warning.

action_items: Remove the stale `search` Tabs.Screen reference in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (file was deleted but layout still mentions it, producing a console warning on every screen).
Optional cosmetic: migrate StyleSheet shadow* props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (carry-over from iter 1).
critical_code_review_comments: All 9 new endpoints (/api/news, /api/news/{id}, /api/lessons, /api/lessons/{id}, /api/templates, /api/templates/{id}) return correct shapes and 404 on missing ids.
Catalog now serves 48 tools, each with `image: https://logo.clearbit.com/{domain}` — verified via /api/tools and via DOM rendering (48 tool-card-* nodes in Catalogue).
Lessons returned sorted by `order` ascending as specified.
Builder live preview correctly reactive: typing in builder-field-role updates builder-preview text, and builder-reset clears the field.
Academy sub-tabs swap content correctly (5 lessons / 8 templates).
Match wizard end-to-end: cta-start-match → match-need-input ('faire un cv') → match-step-next-1 → priority-balanced → match-submit → 8 result cards rendered.
Tool detail rating flow still works: rating-plus → rating-submit shows 'Merci pour ta note !' and persists in MongoDB (verified via /api/ratings/chatgpt count incremented).
Header icons in Catalogue (open-benchmarks, open-compare) successfully navigate to /benchmarks (48 rows) and /compare (two empty slots) — Expo Router nested routes working as designed.

NOTE on DNS errors observed in browser console: many ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED logs come from Playwright's Chromium failing to resolve logo.clearbit.com from inside the test container's egress-restricted network. Real end-users on the public internet will resolve Clearbit fine — this is an infra artefact, not an app bug. Could not visually verify logos render in test env but URLs are correct in API payload.
